label: WHY SEMANTIC AI MATTERS
story: RazorGuard's deterministic rules read the structured projection — which carries NO recurring semantics for this transaction — so they ALLOW. The semantic AI reads the actual commerce evidence against the human authorization and finds the contradiction, BLOCKing through conservative fusion: the ticket is withheld and the provider is contacted zero times. This is the gap the AgentPay-IR v2 corpus targeted; it is also why the structured evidence builder's disclosed limitation (untrusted listing text invisible to structured pairs) matters for the next candidate.
